question: Does the current tree/CEM entry-sizing pipeline outperform practical simpler alternatives on identical qualified opportunities?
baseline: config/p25_validation_2018_2021.json screened, 27 inputs, 18 months, 50/75/100 percent, 10m capital
controls: Reuse hash-verified screened_selected and screened_fixed75 funded ledgers from data/p25_validation_split_experiment.zip; fixed50/100 come from data/submission/artifacts/contracts/p25_capital_sensitivity/replays/10m_fixed50 and10m_fixed100, verified against submission manifest. Confirm selected equals exact reproduced representation raw_full. These are the same controls in validation_split periods.csv.
rank_terciles: At each monthly cutoff, compute rank_strength 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles using eligible completed outcomes in prior 18 months. Map lower/middle/upper scores to 50/75/100 percent. Ties use upper interval. No target or optimizer enters this rule.
ridge_terciles: Standardize same 27 input columns with training means and population SD; constants use SD 1. Fit Ridge with intercept, alpha=n_train, solver svd, to same full-size lifetime P&L target. This minimizes mean squared error plus unit L2 penalty. Map predictions using training-prediction terciles to 50/75/100 percent. No hyperparameter search, CEM, or later-period calibration.
action_space: All six cases use original 50/75/100 ladder. Ridge has a continuous linear score but discretized sizes: retained engine only accepts its declared ladder. Fully continuous action sizes are not tested.
training: 90 monthly fits January 2018 through June 2025, prior 18 months, signal_eligible and finite_label, signal and completed outcome strictly before cutoff. Signal month selects policy.
replay: Same 608 qualified proposals, contracts, directions, initial capital, risk checks, costs, delta hedging and hold-to-expiry policy. Continuous inventory through monthly and evaluation boundaries. Only entry sizes differ; admissions can consequently differ.
interpretation: Comparison of complete practical sizing pipelines, not isolated tree topology: rank/ridge remove CEM and reduce flexibility. No claim that a losing ridge arm excludes all continuous sizing approaches. No zero action in any arm.
selection: Descriptive rankings in both periods; select constant comparator only by validation Sharpe. No automatic strategy promotion. New alternatives were designed after previous research on this history.
uncertainty: Paired circular time-block bootstrap of daily excess returns, 2000 draws, blocks 21/63/126 sessions, seed 2026; report each candidate minus tree. No correction for multiple testing or prior research.
diagnostics: tree training and leaf sample counts
monthly allocation instability on overlapping training examples
yearly and period profit above cash, Sharpe and drawdown
